title: Dispatch: type staff-of-striking per-charge damage (attempt 1)
description:
Implementation dispatch for eshyra-u5wn. Read `bd show eshyra-u5wn` first — its
notes carry the adjudication, the target representation, the precedents, the
acceptance criteria, and what is explicitly out of scope. Do not re-litigate the
representation choice; implement it.

Worktree: `.worktrees/<this-bead-id>`, branch `<this-bead-id>`, cut from branch
`eshyra-u5wn`. Work only inside that worktree.

## Code survey (already done)

- `packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemChargeEconomies.ts`
  ~625 declares the item's economy and `op('powerful-strike', 'variable')`.
  Leave the economy alone — the 1d6+4 dawn recharge and d20 depletion are
  correct and already conserve.
- `packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemCombatModifiers.ts`
  ~779 declares the static `+3` attack/damage bonus. Leave it alone.
- `packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemActivatedEffects.ts`
  has **no** 'Staff of Striking' entry — that is the gap. Add one to its `SPECS`
  map. Helpers: `payload(operationId, kind, value, hooks?, activation?)` at
  ~line 74 builds `id: c2-<operationId>-payload` and binds `operationId`; hook
  constants `F1/F2/F3/F4/F6/F8/F9` are at ~line 20. The model to copy is the
  'Staff of Withering' entry at ~line 1461.
- Each SPECS entry carries `sourcePhrases` that must appear verbatim in the
  emitted description. Verified present in the SRD text:
  `'expend up to 3 of its charges'` and `'extra 1d6 force damage'`.
- `packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts` ~1081 holds the scoped
  exception `'magic-item:staff-of-striking|forward|1d6'` in
  `DICE_NUMERIC_CONSERVATION_EXCEPTIONS`. Remove that entry — the conservation
  gate should now find the token in mechanics. The exhaustive used-exception
  assertion fails on a stale exception, so leaving it would break the build.
- `magic-item:staff-of-withering` shows the emitted shape you are aiming at:
  operation with `effects: ['c2-withering-strike-payload']` and a
  `triggeredEffect` whose nested `extraDamage` carries the dice token.

## Plan

1. Add the 'Staff of Striking' entry to `magicItemActivatedEffects.ts` exactly
   as specified in eshyra-u5wn's notes (payload id `c2-powerful-strike-payload`,
   hooks `[F2, F6, F9]`, free activation triggered by a hit).
2. Regenerate:
   `npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1`
   (confirm the flag against `packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/cli.ts`
   first), then `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`.
3. Review the generated diff: it must touch only `magic-item:staff-of-striking`
   (operation gains `effects` and `activation`; mechanics gain the payload
   effect). Any other record changing is a stop-and-report.
4. Remove the scoped exception from `srdGeneratedPack.test.ts`.
5. Add focused regression coverage in
   `packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemActivatedEffects.test.ts`
   asserting the emitted payload: 1d6, force, per-charge, max 3 charges, bound
   to `powerful-strike`. Check whether family/membership tests
   (`magicItemFamilyRegistry.test.ts`, the M-family coverage tests) need the
   item registered in an additional list — if a test fails because the item is
   newly in the activated-effects family, fix the registration, do not weaken
   the test.

## Constraints

- `docs/importer-fix-protocol.md` governs this work: no hand-edited generated
  records, no weakened audit expectations, and your completion note must report
  affected record IDs, the generated diff, and why each change is expected.
- Do NOT touch `docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/freeze-manifest.json`. Its
  records.json hash already mismatches on `main` (thawed re-audit; re-freeze is
  tracked by eshyra-o9bd.14).
- Do not add a typed variable-cost maximum to the schema and do not add nested
  payload validation — both are explicitly out of scope in eshyra-u5wn.
- `npm ci` first (fresh worktree). `npm run verify:worktree` **before**
  committing (it rewrites files). Commit on your branch.
- Do not push, do not open a PR, do not merge. Never modify eshyra-u5wn.
